book.name: SANTIAGO
book.title: Jesusman Yupachicugcunaman Pipag Maypagsi Santiago Cartacungan

content: Lutan rimayga juchäcachimanchim

Jesusman yupachicug-mayïcuna, ama quiquiquicuna imanuypanuysi ashipäcuychu yachrachig capäcunaypag mana chaypag carcayarga. Musyanganchinuysi noganchi yachrachigcunataga masran Diosga taripämäshun imanuy yachrachinganchipitas.
Lapanchis ima rimaylachrüsi lutanta rimapacuyanchiran. Nätan pisi mana lutanta rimagga ima rimaychrüsi ali rimag runam. Chaynuy runaga Dios munangannuy cawagmi.
Mä shumag tantiapäcunaypag caycunawan tincuchiypa nipäcushay: Noganchiga caballupa shiminman chrurapunchim ichic frënulata, maymansi munanganchiman aywachinanchipag.
Chaynuytan jatun gochrachru alisca walyayaptinsi chay jatun büquita munanganpa aywachipäcun, chay ichic palanca guerulawan.
Chaynuymi gallunchisi cayan ichicla. Nätan chaywanmi ima-aygacunapitas alisca alawacun runaga. Chaynuytan ninasi ichic shanshalapita ratarurga ruparun maychica monticunatas.
Chay ninanuy juyum cayan shiminchichru cayag ichic gallulanchi. Chaywanmi ima lutantas rimanchi. Chaymi lapanchitas juchäcachimanchi, nätan chaywanmi lapan runacunas juchäcurcan Asyag rimachiptin.
Runaga maynuy piña u sima uywacunatas pishgocunatas culebracunatas, jinaman yacuchru cawagcunatas manshuyächinmi.
Nätan chay ichic gallulatam ichaga pi runasi ali rimaglamanga mana muyuchiyta atipanchu. Chayga cayan mana amachay atipänam, jinaman wanuchig venënunuymi.
Nätan chaywanmi Tayta Diosta alawanchi. Chaywantan runa-mayinchipagsi lutanta rimayanchi, quiquin nirayagta Dios camarayaptin.
Chay shimilapitam yargamun ali rimaysi, nätan lutan rimaysi. Jesusman yupachicug-mayïcuna, amam chaynuyga canmanchu.
Manam juclay pucyulapita yargamunchu, mishquig yacu jinaman atgag yacu.

Jesusman yupachicug-mayïcuna, manam juc hïgos monti wayunchu aceitunasta, ni üvas jachrasi manam wayunchu hïgostaga. Manatan juc pucyulapita yargamunchu puchgog yacuwan mishquig yacusi. Chaura chaynuy cayaptinga ama lutanta rimapäcuychu.
Diospitam aywamun ali yachrayga
Gamcunachru maygaysi ali yachrag, jinaman tantiag canganta reguechicuchun ima ruranganchrüsi mana olgotucular, ali cawayninpa.
Nätan shongoycunachru alisca chriquicuyla, jinaman chregninacuyla captinga ama yachragtucurcaychu. Chaynuy jinarga casquicurcayanquim manam razoncagchu.
Manam chaynuy cawanata Diosga munanchu, antis chaynuy lutanpa ricanacuyar cawanataga munapäcun Diosman mana yupachicug runalam, jinaman Asyaglam.
Chaymi runacunaga chriquinacur, jinaman chregninacur cawar, mana alichu cawapäcun, antis chaynuypaga juchatam rurarcayan.
Nätan Diosga yanapämanchi tantiayta mana juchäcular piwansi ali cawanapagmi, cuyapäcug canapagmi, ali rurag canapagmi, pitas alipa ricanapagmi, jinaman razoncagta rimanapagmi.
Chaynuy ali cawapäcuptiquiga waquinsi alim cawapäcunga. Chaynuypam reguechicurcanqui Diospa runan capäcungayta.
